# Taxi Cyprus 24

> Premium private airport taxi transfers across Cyprus. Fixed prices from Larnaca International Airport (LCA) and Paphos International Airport (PFO) to every destination in Cyprus, 24/7, with meet & greet, free child seats and real-time flight tracking.

## Company facts

- Name: Taxi Cyprus 24 (Taxicyprus24)
- Website: https://taxicyprus24.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +357 96 626 844
- Country served: Cyprus (entire island)
- Languages: English, Greek (Ελληνικά), Russian (Русский), German (Deutsch; main airport transfer pages)
- Hours: 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including public holidays
- Currencies accepted: EUR, GBP
- Payment methods: cash, credit/debit card, bank transfer
- Vehicle classes: Executive Sedan (up to 4 pax), 6-Seater Premium Van, 12-Seater Large Van
- Fleet: Mercedes-Benz E-Class sedans and Ford Tourneo Custom / Mercedes vans
- Average rating: 4.9/5 from 120+ TripAdvisor reviews

## What is included in every fixed price

- Meet & greet at airport arrivals with name sign
- Real-time flight tracking — no extra charge for delays
- Free baby, child and booster seats on request
- All taxes and fees
- Luggage assistance
- Bottled water on board
- Private vehicle (never shared)
- Free cancellation up to 24 hours before pickup

## Indicative fixed prices (EUR, total per vehicle)

- Paphos town / Kato Paphos: from €35 (sedan) / €50 (6-seater) / €80 (12-seater)
- Tomb of the Kings: from €40 / €50 / €80
- Coral Bay: from €65 / €85 / €120
- Peyia: from €65 / €85 / €120

- Larnaca: from €140 / €180 / €240
- Nicosia: from €150 / €180 / €240
- Ayia Napa / Protaras: from €200 / €240 / €300

### From Larnaca International Airport (LCA)

## Common journey times

- Larnaca Airport → Paphos: ~1 h 30 min, 140 km, A5 + A6 motorway
- Larnaca Airport → Limassol: ~45 min, 70 km
- Larnaca Airport → Nicosia: ~40 min, 50 km
- Larnaca Airport → Ayia Napa: ~45 min, 65 km
- Paphos Airport → Coral Bay / Peyia: ~25–30 min
- Paphos Airport → Limassol: ~50 min, 65 km
- Paphos Airport → Kato Paphos: ~20 min
- Paphos Airport → Aphrodite Hills: ~20 min
- Paphos Airport → Pissouri: ~30 min
- Paphos Airport → Kissonerga / Tala: ~30 min
- Paphos Airport → Polis / Latchi: ~1 h
- Paphos Airport → Larnaca: ~1 h 30 min, 140 km
- Paphos Airport → Nicosia: ~1 h 50 min – 2 h
